== Biography ==

'''John Glasgow''' was baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 5 October 1738. His birth is given as 4 October 1738 in the MyHeritage-based account and as 4 September 1738 in the Findmypast transcript; the original register is needed to settle the month.<ref name="FMP1738">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3574782&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/3574782], OPR 595/1: John Glasgow, birth 4 September 1738, baptism 5 October 1738, father Rot Glasgow, mother Mary Borland; transcript captured 3 September 2026.</ref> The register names his parents as Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland.<ref>MyHeritage, ''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950'', [https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-305754/john-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms record for John Glasgow], film 1041383.</ref>

A separate index entry of 10 October 1736 again names Robt Glasgow and Mary Borland as the parents of a John Glasgow at Irvine.<ref name="FMP1" /> The 1736 entry therefore probably records an earlier son of the same name who died young rather than this John, and the two entries should not be read as one child.

== Research Notes ==

Both entries carry the same parent names; until the register image is compared, the 1736 entry is kept here as a caution against conflating two same-name siblings.
